advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Fix `_base.py`'s docstring to list the actual mixin modules (`_issues.py`, `_hierarchy.py`, `_links.py`, `_people.py`) instead of the non-existent `_comments.py`/`_properties.py`.
evidence: list_directory output for the package shows only: __init__.py, _base.py, _hierarchy.py, _issues.py, _links.py, _people.py, backend.py, retry.py, settings.py, transitions.py, transport.py — no _comments.py or _properties.py
Ticket 465d comment: "Merged SupportsComments into _links.py and properties into _people.py"
advisory.finding: The `_base.py` module docstring lists `_comments.py` and `_properties.py` as capability mixin modules that inherit `_TransportBase`, but neither file exists — comments are co-located in `_links.py` (`_CommentsMixin`) and properties in `_people.py` (`_PropertiesMixin`). The docstring contradicts the actual layout and the organising-principle note in `__init__.py`/`transport.py`, which is precisely the ‘determined home’ map the ticket AC says must be accurate.
advisory.suggested_fix: Replace the parenthetical in _base.py's docstring with the real modules: ``(_issues.py, _hierarchy.py, _links.py, _people.py)``, noting comments live in _links.py and properties in _people.py.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Point the pagination structural guard (_TRANSPORT_SRC / _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default) at the relocated caller modules (_base.py, _issues.py, _hierarchy.py, _links.py) so it once again fails on an unpaginated search_issues call after the split.
evidence: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py:155: `tree = ast.parse(src if src is not None else _TRANSPORT_SRC.read_text())` — the live guard scans transport.py only
search_files: `search_issues` now appears only in _base.py:147, _issues.py:119/123, _hierarchy.py:59 (docstring); zero occurrences in transport.py after the move

_base.py:138-139: `A structural test now fails the build if any caller takes the ``search_issues`` default again (bug 9263).` — this docstring guarantee is now false because the guard no longer scans the file(s) holding the callers

ABSENCE rationale: no diff hunk updates _TRANSPORT_SRC (or adds the mixin modules to the scan) to follow the relocated callers, and the ticket's 'no test assertion edited' constraint explicitly prevented it
advisory.finding: The relocation silently defeats the existing structural pagination guard (bug 9263): test_no_search_issues_call_relies_on_the_default_page_size AST-scans only transport.py via the hard-coded _TRANSPORT_SRC path, but this change moved _paged_search and every search_issues call out of transport.py into _base.py/_issues.py (and the whole-project readers into _hierarchy.py/_links.py), leaving transport.py with no search_issues call at all. The guard now passes vacuously and can no longer detect a fourth unpaginated whole-project reader added to any mixin file.
scenarios: A future parent/link/comment operation adds a bare self._client.search_issues(jql) (default maxResults=50) to _hierarchy.py or _links.py; the guard, scanning only transport.py, stays green and the 250-vs-50 silent-truncation defect class recurs undetected.
advisory.suggested_fix: Replace the single _TRANSPORT_SRC target with the set of jira_datacenter/_*.py modules that can now hold search_issues callers (at minimum _base.py, _issues.py, _hierarchy.py, _links.py) and scan each; keep the synthetic-offender teeth test. Alternatively glob the whole jira_datacenter package directory.
